intent: End Episode 01 without a moral scorecard. Carry record quality, reporting climate, instruction habits, and the player's chosen recovery mode into the first observable conditions of Day 02.

authoring_gate_checked.safety_floor: No prior success, relationship, recovery choice, or clean record grants automatic safety clearance on Day 02.
authoring_gate_checked.field_accounts: Carry social reporting climate and instruction reception forward; do not reduce yesterday to management paperwork alone.
authoring_gate_checked.legitimate_pressure: Fatigue, family life, need for sleep, desire to learn, and desire to record are all legitimate after-shift pressures.
authoring_gate_checked.route_costs: Each evening route gains a different resource while leaving a different information or recovery gap.
authoring_gate_checked.delayed_consequence: Day 02 begins by observing what workers say, what instructions reach the end user, and what unresolved record state has become accepted truth.

presentation_rules: Do not rank rest, family time, study, or field notes as morally better or worse recovery choices.
Do not summarize Episode 01 as a single score or correct-answer percentage.
Carry both technical records and human reporting climate into Day 02.
Even favorable Day 01 outcomes are starting conditions, not automatic clearance.
